# Restart regression fixtures

These 24 JPEG files encode an original 33x19 RGB pattern generated by
`scripts/generate-restart-fixtures.js` (project license). They cover baseline
and progressive Huffman coding in GRAY, 4:4:4, 4:2:2, and 4:2:0 with restart
intervals of 0, 1, and 3 MCUs. In single-component scans an MCU is one block.
The odd dimensions also exercise partial MCU rows and columns.

Generated with the locally built libjpeg-turbo cjpeg. Recreate with
`node scripts/generate-restart-fixtures.js`; set `CJPEG_PATH` if needed.
`sha256.json` records each fixture checksum. Tests use committed fixtures
and do not require cjpeg to be installed.
